title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-114-26二模

items.zh: 应该让孩子们知道谁才是他们该追的星。
items.en: Children should be taught who they should idolize.

items.zh: 这款翻译软件非常精准,已被联合国多个部门采用。
items.en: This translation app is so accurate that it has been adopted by multiple departments of the United Nations.

items.zh: 直到最终数据呈现在面前，他们才意识到之前的传说并非空穴来风。
items.en: They didn’t realize that the earlier rumors were not entirely misplaced until the final data were presented to them.

items.zh: 这种新型材料的研发已在我们的太空实验室获得突破,它不仅轻如羽毛,而且强度堪比钢铁,已应用于航天领域。
items.en: A breakthrough in the new material development has been made in our space lab—one that is not only as light as a feather but also as strong as steel, already applied in the aerospace industry.
